name: postgres
description: Reads PostgreSQL tables, supports PostgreSQL 14+ logical-replication CDC into the local warehouse, and delivers managed PostgreSQL targets through the warehouse-mediated transport. Direct Connector.Write remains unavailable; query is not implemented.

risk.write: not a generic write capability; the closed managed target transport follows its existing plan, preview, approval, execute boundary
risk.approval: source reads require none; managed target transport follows its plan, preview, approval, execute boundary
